strategy.text: Put the ruled equation everywhere a name is produced or checked while the model stays frozen. The flowchart shows the ruling flowing into validators, mirror, policy, tests, journeys, deployment, and docs.

what-the-diff-actually-built.text: The equation and fold, retire, and burn bindings in the application validator, registry-scoped mint, burn, and withdrawal in the representative validator, the same equation at the consumer hook, a byte-exact Haskell mirror, seed-before-policy deployment with attached derivation, the docs paragraph, and required check contexts on every pull request.

verification-as-shipped.text: Docs checks green, full Aiken, consumer, Haskell, and identity suites green, devnet folds with the true mint, a planted preimage that fails and is removed, named refusals, and a green retirement journey.

file-fence-what-the-merge-touched.text: Thirty-six files, all outside the Lean directory: validators, tests, identities, runners, mirror, docs page, and workflows.

slice.text: One slice: the computable name with registry-bound policy and witnessed retirement, shipped as nine commits from policy binding to required checks.
